name: Norway
convention: Norges Bank settlement (NBO) closure days: statutory holidays plus Christmas Eve. KEY FINDING: Dec 31 is NOT a Norwegian bank/settlement closure day (Norges Bank's rules name 'holidays, public holidays and Christmas Eve' — New Year's Eve is absent), unlike Sweden and Denmark. Maundy Thursday IS a holiday (unlike FI/SE). Weekend-falling named holidays included, flagged in notes.
sources: Norges Bank 'Rammevilkår … Norges Banks oppgjørssystem' (PDF) — the closure-day rule incl. the Christmas Eve / New Year's Eve distinction
notes: Weekend-falling entries kept: 2025-05-17 (Sat), 2026-05-17 (Sun), 2027-05-01 (Sat), 2027-12-25 (Sat), 2027-12-26 (Sun). Norway has no substitute-day shifting.
2027-05-17: Constitution Day and Whit Monday coincide on the same date — listed once. A good resolver test: two rules resolving to one date must yield a set, not a duplicate.
No Epiphany, no Dec 31 — both differ from Sweden.
